text: ひどいなア　そんな　らんぼうに　しなくても…

structure.jp: そんな　らんぼうに　しなくても…
structure.en: you didn't have to be that rough...

patterns.name: 〜なくても
patterns.explanation: なくても means 'even without doing'. Here the sentence trails off and leaves 'it would be fine' unsaid, which makes it a complaint. らんぼうに　しなくても = 'you didn't have to be rough'.

patterns.name: 〜に (adverb)
patterns.explanation: に after this kind of describing word lets it tell how an action is done. らんぼうに = 'roughly'.
